preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1 for the graph to be a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= vi <= 10**9 for vi in values)
preconditions.description: Each integer value on the vertices must be within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of moves required to make all vertex values equal to zero.
